FAQs on Plugin

How Do I Update the Simulator?

The current version does not support automatic simulator update. To update the simulator, perform the following steps manually:

  1. Obtain the plugin installation location. The default plugin installation directories vary according to OSs.

    • Windows %USERPROFILE%\.vscode\extensions
    • macOS ~/.vscode/extensions

  2. Select the %USERPROFILE %\\.vscode\extensions\macleteam.macle-miniprogram-tools-[version-no]\src\utils\simulator directory. version-no indicates the plugin version.

  3. Replace the simulator. The simulator varies according to the OS. Currently, the Linux OS is not supported.

    • Windows :Decompress the simulator package to the Windows directory in Step 2.
    • macOS :Decompress the simulator package to the macOS directory in Step 2.

  4. After the replacement is complete, click the clear cache function to clear the cache information of the original simulator.

What Do I Do If the Simulator Page Keeps Loading and Mini Program Cannot Be Displayed After the Plugin Is Updated?

  1. Obtain the Mini Program directory. The Mini Program directories vary according to OSs.

    • Windows %USERPROFILE%\.macle\
    • macOS ~/.macle/

  2. Delete the .macle folders from the directories in Step 1.

What Do I Do If the Plugin Version Is Still the Original Version After the Plugin Is Updated?

After the plugin is updated, click the pop-up message in the lower right corner of the VS Code to reload the VS Code.

After an exception occurs in the simulator, the simulator debugging function always shows that it is starting. How to solve it?

After an unknown exception occurs when the simulator starts, the status will change to starting. You can reset the simulator status by closing the current window and restarting vscode.
